title: Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning
abstract: arXiv:2610.41040v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents serve natural-language requests through tools, data sources, and other agents, and even simple requests often need several interdependent calls. Typically, the LLM picks these calls by trial and error, with no guarantee of an executable plan. We present Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning (CGAP), which instead reasons about what a request requires and what tools provide. CGAP compiles the tool catalog deterministically into a PDDL model, uses an LLM to turn the request into goals, and solves the model with a classical planner. Since tool outputs are unknown in advance, the model is abstract, tracking which inputs are available, not their values. During execution, an LLM adds entity-specific calls that abstract plans omit, and deterministic checks reject any that break the plan. Every argument is drawn from a cited source, such as a conversation span or an earlier tool response, and each requested result counts as delivered

translated_title: 基于能力接地的智能体规划
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过工具、数据源和其他智能体来服务自然语言请求，即使是简单的请求也常常需要多个相互依赖的调用。通常情况下，LLM 通过反复试错来选择这些调用，无法保证得到一个可执行的计划。我们提出了基于能力接地的智能体规划（Capability-Grounded Agentic Planning，CGAP），它转而推理请求需要什么以及工具能提供什么。CGAP 将工具目录确定性地编译为 PDDL 模型，使用 LLM 将请求转化为目标，并用经典规划器求解该模型。由于工具输出事先未知，该模型是抽象的，只跟踪哪些输入可用，而不跟踪其具体值。在执行过程中，LLM 会添加抽象计划所省略的、与具体实体相关的调用，而确定性检查会拒绝任何破坏计划的调用。每个参数都取自被引用的来源，例如对话片段或先前的工具响应，且每个被请求的结果都被计为已交付。
tldr: CGAP 通过将工具目录确定性编译为抽象 PDDL 模型并使用经典规划器求解，使 LLM 智能体生成的计划天然可执行，同时在执行时由 LLM 补充实体系调用并通过确定性检查确保不破坏原计划。
en_tdlr: CGAP replaces trial-and-error LLM tool selection with capability-grounded planning that compiles tool catalogs into abstract PDDL models solved by a classical planner, guaranteeing executable agentic plans while an LLM adds entity-specific calls verified by deterministic checks at execution time.
